data.title: The $1.7 Trillion Job Apocalypse: Why Investors Can’t Ignore Humanoid Robots
data.description: AI has already gutted white-collar tech jobs by the hundreds of thousands, but the next wave targets something far bigger: the physical economy and the wages of workers who never touched a keyboard.
